high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the Washington Post's official account. The post features a dramatic photograph of a forest fire, with flames engulfing trees and casting an orange glow over the scene. The title of the post reads, "‘A code red for humanity’" in bold white letters against the fiery background. Below the title, there is a subtitle that states: "Humans have pushed the climate into ‘unprecedented’ territory, a landmark U.N. report finds.
